partB_forcedTimeout.description: Same client, per-attempt deadline 1.5s so the first segment aborts. Proves: (1) multi-segment input gets maxRetries 0 -> exactly one HTTP call, (2) the timeout is rethrown (retryOn 'transient' covers only 429/503), (3) the wrapper re-labels it status 400, which the worker's isPermanent() treats as terminal on attempt 1.
